title: HEAR PROTESTS against the proposed improvement and maintenance of the 96th Street and Bellanca Avenue Street Lighting District, in accordance with Sections…
text:
[Council File 26-0900-S17; CD 11]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
HEAR PROTESTS against the proposed improvement and maintenance of the 96th Street and Bellanca Avenue Street Lighting District, in accordance with Sections 6.95-6.127 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code and Proposition 218.​ (Pursuant to Council adoption of Ordinance of Intention on September 22, 2026. The tabulation of ballots shall take place in Space 300 of 555 Ramirez Street on December 2, 2026 at 10 a.m. and will be publicly live-streamed. To access the live stream, join Zoom Meeting ID: 165 416 7710, Passcode: prop218. Public announcement of the tabulation of ballots and consideration of the Final Ordinance will take place at Council on January 12, 2027.)
summary: Hearing on protests against a proposed street lighting district for 96th Street and Bellanca Avenue in Council District 11, covering its improvement and maintenance under Proposition 218. Ballots are tabulated December 2, with the final ordinance set for January 12, 2027.
